body.text: Most writing is harder to read than its author thinks. Long sentences stack up, jargon creeps in, and the reader quietly gives up. ReadScore shows you the problem before anyone else sees it.

Paste any text into ReadScore and it scores the readability instantly. You get word, sentence, and paragraph counts, reading and speaking time, a Flesch Reading Ease score with plain-English label, and a grade level. A sentence-length map flags every sentence over 24 words, and a word-frequency view shows the words you use most.

items: Marketers who need copy anyone can read
Anyone who wants plain, readable writing
Paste your text into the box
Check the readability score and grade level
Re-paste and watch the score improve

body.text: ReadScore is $8 a month, or $40 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
